service.title: What Dhathuru does
service.body: Dhathuru plans and books multi-leg journeys across the Maldives with independent transport operators. Each operator remains responsible for its own service.

bookings.title: Bookings and changes
bookings.body: A booking is held briefly while you pay. Cancellation and refund rules follow each operator's policy and are shown before you pay.

accuracy.title: Accuracy of information
accuracy.body: Timetables, fares and delay statistics come from operators and public sources and can change. Estimated figures are marked as estimates.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: Your account details, the travellers you save and the trips you book. We do not sell personal data.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: To plan and book journeys, send tickets and trip notifications, and keep the service secure.

rights.title: Your choices
rights.body: You can edit your details, remove saved travellers and delete your account from your profile.
